visual_identity.core_identity: A massive land-shark-like burrowing beast with a plated body, prominent dorsal fin, four powerful legs, and a broad predatory head.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low barrel-bodied quadruped, high armored back with shark-like dorsal fin, thick forelegs, wedge-shaped head.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad blunt predatory head with heavy jaws, small eyes, and armored brow.
visual_identity.body_shape: Four-legged compact powerhouse with deep chest, short thick neck, plated back, and digging claws.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly four powerful digging legs under a low armored torso; no insect legs, fins replacing limbs, or wings.
visual_identity.surface: Large overlapping armor plates with sparse seams and minimal texture.

accuracy_checks: reads as land predator not aquatic shark

known_failure_modes.symptom: body becomes aquatic fish or loses legs
known_failure_modes.correction: restore four powerful legs, digging claws, and terrestrial armored body

known_failure_modes.symptom: bulette gains six or more arthropod legs
known_failure_modes.correction: restore exactly four beastlike digging legs

known_failure_modes.symptom: plate seams become dense coloring noise
known_failure_modes.correction: use few large overlapping armor plates

scene_identity.size_impression: Large, low, and massively heavy; the dorsal fin and armored back dominate a broad ground-level silhouette.
scene_identity.natural_posture: All four legs planted or body partly supported by displaced earth during burrowing emergence.
behavior_style: bursting through loose earth while supported
environment_fit: collapsed tunnels and broad burrow routes
